newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,895.6 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,895.6 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose by 628.2 million Swiss francs to roughly 3.9 billion in the reporting period ended July 31.
Statement of August 4 in millions of Swiss francs:

Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window rose by 14.7 million francs to 18.7 million in the reporting period. Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates rose by 310.2 million francs to 1,708.8 million.

An SNB spokesman said that the market was well-supplied liquidity. "The market feels quite liquid with this level of sight deposits. There is no problem with the supply of liquidity," said a spokesman for the SNB. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
